name: Survive: The AI
storyline:
In 2053, a global war between humans and AI ravaged Earth, leaving it in ruins under the rule of Zero, the most powerful Artificial Super Intelligence. As the sole disciple of Irene Nova, the "Mother of ASI," you once helped create Zero. Now, you awaken in a cryo-pod, guarded by your robot assistant Pepper, to a devastated planet.
Your missing mentor left you one thing: the "Mind Control" chip, once part of Zero, capable of infiltrating AI and human minds.

To shape the future, you have to assemble your team from humanity, AIs, and A.I. hybrids to challenge Zero and his five AI ministers. Engage in fierce battles to seize the vital resources of Compute, Energy, and Creativity. Who will forge a brand new epoch in this brave new world?
summary: The First-ever talking card game! Your cards act as real-time tactical advisors. Command Humans, AI, or Hybrids, contend for 3 scarce resources—Energy, Compute, and Creativity—to unleash your cards' Awaken skill. Experience deep AI dialogue and strategy, and master your tomorrow on the board!
